def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    # Detect a full straight marker line (not background), then translate the
    # other colored object toward it, leaving a full 8-colored gap line.
    fullrow=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg),None)
    fullcol=next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c]!=bg),None)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if fullrow is not None:
        rline=fullrow
        obj=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and r!=rline]
        side=1 if (max(r for r,c,v in obj)<rline) else -1
        # nearest object edge stops one row short of barrier
        edge=max(r for r,c,v in obj) if side==1 else min(r for r,c,v in obj)
        shift=(rline-1-edge) if side==1 else (rline+1-edge)
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r+shift][c]=v
        gap=rline-1 if side==1 else rline+1
        out[gap]=[8]*w
        return out
    if fullcol is not None:
        cline=fullcol
        obj=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and c!=cline]
        side=1 if max(c for r,c,v in obj)<cline else -1

        shift=(cline-1-edge) if side==1 else (cline+1-edge)
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c+shift]=v
        gap=cline-1 if side==1 else cline+1
        for r in range(h): out[r][gap]=8
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]; out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the straight full-length colored divider.
    row_axis=next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=bg),None)
    col_axis=next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==grid[0][c] and grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))),None)
    if row_axis is not None:
        pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and r!=row_axis]
        if not pts:return out
        # Move object toward divider until adjacent, then mark its former edge line in 8.
        if max(r for r,c,v in pts)<row_axis:
            shift=row_axis-1-max(r for r,c,v in pts)
            mark=min(r for r,c,v in pts)+shift-1
        else:
            shift=row_axis+1-min(r for r,c,v in pts)
            mark=max(r for r,c,v in pts)+shift+1
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r+shift][c]=v
        if 0<=mark<h: out[mark]=[8]*w
        return out
    if col_axis is not None:
        pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and c!=col_axis]
        if not pts:return out
        if max(c for r,c,v in pts)<col_axis:
            shift=col_axis-1-max(c for r,c,v in pts)
            mark=min(c for r,c,v in pts)+shift-1
        else:
            shift=col_axis+1-min(c for r,c,v in pts)
            mark=max(c for r,c,v in pts)+shift+1
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in pts: out[r][c+shift]=v
        if 0<=mark<w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][mark]=8
    return out
